description: MAXY Fill 55cc is a Korean large-volume, high-viscosity cross-linked hyaluronic acid body filler supplied as a single 55cc unit for non-surgical body contouring. It is a firm ("Hard") cohesive gel formulated for deep-plane placement in areas that require structural volume and projection. Manufactured by Quiver Medic using HENM cross-linking technology.
howItWorks: A highly cross-linked, high-G' hyaluronic acid gel is deposited in the deep subcutaneous and supra-periosteal planes, where its cohesivity and elasticity provide durable structural volume and contour projection. The HENM cross-linking is intended to resist enzymatic degradation and displacement so the gel holds its shape at the placement site. Volume is gradually resorbed over time and can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if correction is required.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid, reported at approximately 20 mg/mL (HENM cross-linking), non-animal origin; 55cc volume. Some distributors list added lidocaine, but lidocaine content is not consistently confirmed across sources.
usageNotes: For deep subcutaneous / deep-plane placement by a trained injector, typically via blunt cannula under strict aseptic technique. Because large volumes are involved, staged sessions and conservative per-area dosing are advised; aspirate and use retrograde technique to reduce intravascular risk. Being HA-based, it is reversible with hyaluronidase.
features: High-viscosity, cohesive "Hard" formulation for structural support
benefits: Non-surgical alternative to implants or fat transfer for large-area volumizing
Cohesive gel supports predictable, position-stable contouring
Reversibility with hyaluronidase supports risk management
Large-volume single unit streamlines stocking for high-volume body cases
Suited to an enquiry-to-order clinical workflow for body procedures
indications: Hip dip correction and hip contouring
Post-liposuction soft-tissue restoration and deep volume replacement

description: Hyalmass 60cc is a Korean hyper-cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler from Maypharm, supplied as a large 60cc vial for body augmentation. It is formulated with Maypharm's Hybrid (Hy-BRID) cross-linking technology to produce a dense, high-lift HA gel for large-volume contouring. The vial format is intended for convenience and efficiency in extensive body procedures.
howItWorks: The hyper-cross-linked HA gel is placed in deep tissue planes where its high density and viscoelasticity provide strong lift and durable volume across large areas. The dense cross-linked matrix is designed for high lifting capacity and resistance to breakdown, maintaining contour until gradual resorption. It is dissolvable with hyaluronidase for correction.

usageNotes: For deep-plane placement by a trained injector via blunt cannula from the vial under strict asepsis.
